== Personal Wiki Generator ==
This website itself is a project! A static site generator that converts [[Wikipedia|MediaWiki]] markup to HTML.

* '''Source''': MediaWiki markup files in <code>pages/</code> directory
* '''Build''': Node.js script converts markup to HTML
* '''Deployment''': Pure static HTML files
